input.quote: 12.1 Term. The term of this Agreement shall commence upon the Effective Date and, unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Article XII, shall continue in full force and effect until the expiration of Sanofi's payment obligations under Article IX or the Profit/Loss Share Agreement, whichever is later (the "Term").
input.rationale: This is a collaboration/license agreement, not a renewing subscription. Section 12.1 sets a single term running until expiration of Sanofi's payment obligations under Article IX or the Profit/Loss Share Agreement, with no automatic renewal, no renewal term length, no non-renewal notice window and no renewal price-uplift mechanic (searches for "renew"/"extend" return only patent-term and insurance references). There is therefore no auto-renewal exit or pricing risk to cap, and Sanofi additionally holds broad termination-for-convenience and other termination rights under Section 12.2(a). The rule's subject matter is effectively inapplicable and there is nothing adverse to us to redline; it meets the preferred outcome (no unilateral automatic extension binding the customer).
